question: A man spends 74% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹385 on conveyance and ₹2,725 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹621, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total remaining percentage after paying rent = 100% − 74% = 26%

Total value of the remaining components = 385 + 2725 + 621 = 3731

Since 26% of the Salary = ₹3731

Total Salary = 3731 ÷ 26 × 100 = 14350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
